name: mql5-codegraph-intelligence
description: Evidence-backed local MQL5 project and reference intelligence

interface.shortDescription: Navigate MQL5 code and cited reference evidence.
interface.longDescription: Index trusted local MQL5 repositories in memory, attach operator-built reference corpora, query source relationships and page-cited documentation, trace impact and paths, correlate bounded compiler logs, and assemble AI context without modifying source or corpus files.
defaultPrompt: Index this MQL5 project and explain its architecture.
Trace the impact of changing this MQL5 symbol.
Search my attached MQL5 reference corpus with physical-page citations.
Correlate this project's supplied MetaEditor compiler log.
Run the MQL5 static-analysis release gate.
